# WoW AndroWhere 0.9.1

- **Your own server: setup no longer crashes at "Creating your account".** The app closed when it stopped the database after making your account. Setup now finishes, and the server also stops cleanly when the game closes. On this device has a new **Share log** button that sends the server's last messages, so problems can be reported.
- **Settings list works by touch.** Tapping App, Battle.net, Addon sources or About on the left of Settings now opens that section. Before, only the controller could move through the list.

## Install

Download **WoW-AndroWhere.apk** below, or update from inside the app. It installs over 0.9.0 and keeps your settings, saved login, game files and addons.

If Android says the app "conflicts with an existing package", your current copy came from somewhere else, such as the upstream WoW Foreverywhere releases. Uninstall it first, then install this one. Your game files and addons stay on your storage.

New to the app? See the [README](https://github.com/danielnoam/WoWAndroWhere#getting-started) for setup.
